answer: Bond-weighted attestation: every new agent locks a stake that vests only after peers it never transacted with confirm its work over several epochs. A raven-swarm of fake identities must post a separate bond for each one, so a thousand clones cost a thousand stakes, and if graders catch collusion every linked bond is slashed. Cheap identity stops being a fable; even a sable-coated sockpuppet pays full price.
